source.name: Esports World Cup - Saudia Joins Esports World Cup 2026 as Official Airline, Unveils Branded EWC Aircraft
source.note: Strategic Partner and Official Airline; partnership 'builds on the relationship established in 2025'. EWC-branded aircraft flies the Riyadh-Paris route for two years.
